user.title: Choose Bluetooth adapter
user.description: Home Assistant pairs Bluetooth speakers and plays audio through this adapter. Audio and keep-awake only work on Home Assistant OS or Supervised.

abort.no_adapter: No Bluetooth adapter found. Is it plugged in or passed through to the VM?

data.auto_reconnect: Reconnect automatically (only speakers with keep-awake on)
data.default_output: Make a connected speaker the Home Assistant audio output
data.keepalive_noise: Keep awake with very faint noise instead of silence (if the speaker turns off despite silence)
